components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Accent-filled capsule for the primary action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #050608; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 999px; font: 600 0.875rem/1.5 'Onest', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet capsule action with hover tint, not a competing primary.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 999px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.5 'Onest', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--glass-tint-hover-bg); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: auto; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Tint-tier field with accent border on focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="search" aria-label="Search library" placeholder="Search library">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--glass-tint-bg); color: var(--text); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 999px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'Onest', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); }

components.name: TopBar Navigation Pill
components.description: Translucent pill whose active route is carried by the moving glass lens.
components.html: LibrarySettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 48px; padding: 3px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--pill-bg); color: var(--text-muted); border: 1px solid var(--pill-border-color); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: var(--pill-shadow); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--pill-blur); backdrop-filter: var(--pill-blur); } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 13px; color: inherit; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 1rem/1.2 'Onest', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: auto; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact capsule filter; selected state uses the accent.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-subtle); padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.4 'Onest', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--text); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: auto; }

components.name: Game Card
components.description: Portrait artwork card with hover lift and a refractive title lens.
components.css: .ds-game-card { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; background: transparent; color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: var(--glass-tint-edge); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 0.2s; } .ds-game-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 0 24px var(--accent-glow), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08) inset; } .ds-cover { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; background: var(--surface-3); } .ds-game-title { display: block; padding: 8px 12px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text); font: 600 0.875rem/1.3 'Onest', sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-game-card:focus-visible { outline: auto; }

components.name: Liquid Tooltip
components.description: Compact Tier-1 glass label attached to a control.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--liquid-glass-bg); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: var(--liquid-glass-edge), var(--shadow-lg); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--liquid-glass-blur); backdrop-filter: var(--liquid-glass-blur); font: 500 0.75rem/1.4 'Onest', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Scanner Progress Track
components.description: Compact, semantic progress stage for a running scan.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-1); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-progress span { display: block; width: 62%; height: 100%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: inherit; transition: width 0.2s ease; }

narrative.overview:
kr8bit is a calm collector's den: a dense library held in a dark, quiet field, with translucent surfaces that reveal rather than conceal. The interface treats each game as an artifact to browse, not a tile in a generic admin grid. Glass is the material language; responsive glow, refraction, and small spring-like motions give controls a pressable, alive quality without changing the work surface into an arcade spectacle.

The same visual grammar survives the light theme: cool gallery neutrals replace the dark room while indigo remains the identifying accent. Active navigation is marked by a moving liquid-glass lens; category accents appear through its refracted copy, not as permanent colored tabs. The application name remains kr8bit; the North Star is a design metaphor, not a rename.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet collector's den, built around a browsable game library.
Three glass treatments: liquid, blurred surface, and blur-free tint.
Indigo identity with restrained per-section color accents.
Responsive, spring-led feedback; reduced-motion preferences honored.

rules.name: The Two-Theme Rule
rules.body: Keep each semantic role paired across [data-theme='dark'] and [data-theme='light']; do not substitute unrelated one-off colors for a theme-specific token.

rules.name: The Blur Budget Rule
rules.body: Preserve the tier split: do not add backdrop blur to each dense grid card or to the full-screen detail backdrop. The detail card already carries its own glass blur; the backdrop stays a plain dim overlay to avoid repeated rasterization during motion and video playback.

dos: Do use CSS custom properties from web/src/styles.css as the source of truth; keep dark/light counterparts aligned by semantic role.
Do keep active navigation expressed through the moving lens, with route color visible through its refracted copy.
Do keep dense card collections in the blur-free tier; use hover lift and the cover lens for stateful depth.
Do preserve the game-cover aspect ratio, virtualized responsive grid, and bottom-sheet dialog behavior.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion; pointer-driven tilt/glow is gated for reduced-motion and coarse-pointer contexts.
donts: Don't add a new branded color or surface recipe where a semantic token already exists.
Don't apply backdrop blur to every game card or to the full-screen dialog backdrop.
Don't turn the active top-bar route into a permanently tinted tab; the lens carries that state.
Don't rely on motion, hover, or tooltip alone to communicate control name or keyboard focus.
Don't copy obsolete selectors or values from docs/tweak-reference.md when they conflict with current web/src/styles.css.
